messages:
Ravi: Quick sketch  compress the org invoice list by moving token breakdowns into a lazy 'details' chevron. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/compact-spend-row.png
Nora: Love the density win. Two constraints: CSV exports must remain deterministic and auditors need project_id present even when collapsed.
Ben: Accessibility note: the chevron must be a native <button> with aria-expanded/aria-controls. When breakdown finishes loading announce via aria-live polite.
Ari: Discoverability worry  users might not notice collapsed details. Suggest small inline copy: "2.3k tokens — click for breakdown" and a 'New' badge for the first week after rollout.
Ravi: Agreed on copy. Also prefer lazy-render on expand to avoid DOM bloat for huge org lists.
Nora: Backend change: add /invoices/:id?expand_breakdowns=true that returns expanded rows server-side for exports. CSV should include units_type and project_id columns.
Ben: Keyboard: Enter/Space toggles, arrow keys jump between rows, focus moves into expanded content when opened. Add skip link for screenreader users.
access-bot: A11y checklist: focus visible, contrast >=4.5, aria-live for count updates, tooltip text reachable by keyboard, no color-only state.
Ari: Small perf note: debounce rapid expand attempts and throttle audit logs for expansions so logs don't explode.
Ravi: Dev estimates: frontend ~2 days (chevron + lazy render + copy), backend ~1-2 days (export param + CSV shape), QA + a11y pass ~1 day.
Nora: Acceptance criteria: collapsed by default for org view, visible inline summary, lazy render on expand, server-side expand param for exports, aria attributes + aria-live, keyboard flows documented.
Ravi: Assigning: @ravi frontend, @nora backend, @ben a11y review. Will file tickets and post updated mock here when ready. :sparkles:
